html:
G'oya

Ikki ish bor. Birinchisi, bo'sh oylarni ham chiqarish: buning uchun avval birinchi va oxirgi buyurtma oyi orasidagi barcha oylar kalendari yasaladi, tushum unga LEFT JOIN qilinadi. Ikkinchisi, oldingi oy bilan solishtirish: LAG(revenue) kalendar ustida ishlaydi, shuning uchun bo'sh oydan keyingi oy 0 bilan solishtiriladi.

Yechim

Faqat PostgreSQLWITH RECURSIVE cal(month_start) AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(order_date))::date FROM orders
  UNION ALL
  SELECT (month_start + INTERVAL '1 month')::date FROM cal
  WHERE month_start < (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', MAX(order_date))::date FROM orders)
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, SUM(amount) AS revenue
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY TO_CHAR(order_date, 'YYYY-MM')
),
all_months AS (
  SELECT TO_CHAR(c.month_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COALESCE(m.revenue, 0) AS revenue
  FROM cal c
  LEFT JOIN monthly m ON m.month = TO_CHAR(c.month_start, 'YYYY-MM')
  WHERE c.month_start IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT month, revenue,
       ROUND((revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) * 100.0
             / NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM all_months
ORDER BY month

NULLIF(x, 0) 0 ni NULL ga aylantiradi, NULL ga bo'lish esa NULL beradi. Birinchi oyda LAG o'zi NULL. Shu bilan ikkala NULL holati bitta ifodada yopiladi. 100.0 kasrli bo'lish uchun kerak: 3000 dan 4000 ga o'sish 33.3, butun sonlarda esa 33 chiqardi.

Tuzoqlar

Kalendarsiz LAG namunada 2024-04 ni 2024-02 bilan solishtiradi: mart jadvalda yo'q, shuning uchun u natijada ham bo'lmaydi. To'g'ri javobda mart 0 bilan turadi va aprel uchun growth_pct NULL.

SQLite'da kalendarni oy boshidan boshlang. 2024-01-31 dan '+1 month' 2024-03-02 ni beradi va fevral kalendardan tushib qoladi:

Noto'g'riWITH RECURSIVE cal(ms) AS (
  SELECT MIN(order_date) FROM orders
  UNION ALL
  SELECT date(ms, '+1 month') FROM cal
  WHERE ms < (SELECT date(MAX(order_date), 'start of month') FROM orders)
)
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', ms) AS month FROM cal

Dialektlar farqi

SQLite'da oy boshi date(d, 'start of month'), oy kaliti strftime('%Y-%m', d):

Faqat SQLiteWITH RECURSIVE cal(month_start) AS (
  SELECT date(MIN(order_date), 'start of month') FROM orders
  UNION ALL
  SELECT date(month_start, '+1 month') FROM cal
  WHERE month_start < (SELECT date(MAX(order_date), 'start of month') FROM orders)
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, SUM(amount) AS revenue
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', order_date)
),
all_months AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', c.month_start) AS month, COALESCE(m.revenue, 0) AS revenue
  FROM cal c
  LEFT JOIN monthly m ON m.month = strftime('%Y-%m', c.month_start)
  WHERE c.month_start IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT month, revenue,
       ROUND((revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) * 100.0
             / NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM all_months
ORDER BY month

Nolga bo'lishda bazalar har xil yo'l tutadi. PostgreSQL division by zero xatosi bilan to'xtaydi, SQLite esa jim NULL qaytaradi. NULLIF ni SQLite'da unutsangiz ham javob to'g'ri chiqadi, PostgreSQL'da esa so'rov umuman ishlamaydi.
